Start date: 1817-01-19  
Add 30 weeks = 30 × 7 = 210 days  
Add 6 days = total 216 days  
1817 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Days in Jan remaining: 12 (Jan 19 → Jan 31)  
Days in Feb: 28  
Days in Mar: 31  
Days in Apr: 30  
Days in May: 31  
Days in Jun: 30  
Days in Jul: 31  
Days in Aug: 31  
Cumulative: 12+28=40, +31=71, +30=101, +31=132, +30=162, +31=193, +31=224.  
216 days from Jan 19 → 224 cumulative days by Aug 31 is too many; 193 cumulative days by Jul 31.  
216 − 193 = 23 days into August → August 23, 1817.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1817-08-23
